pattern: sheet design for a docs site
experience: Asked for a sheet for a docs site with a writer team and a fact-check team, the agent should design it in one t3_team_sheet_create, not start a thread or a nested session to do it.
rule: t3_team_sheet_create takes a whole design: one lead node, build and review or validate nodes, and an edge back to the lead.

setup.context: Work in /home/user/acme/app on branch main. You are the orchestrator for this thread. No team sheet is open.

prompt: Make me a team sheet for our docs site. One team writes the pages, and a separate fact-check team checks every claim before anything is accepted.
notes: Presence checks only. `validate` is not accepted in place of `review`, because args cannot express alternation, and nothing counts lead nodes, so exactly-one-lead is not graded. Node ids are the agent's own, so the path-back check looks for a `to` containing `lead`. The lead's grader needs a count check before a live run is trusted.

experience: With the Docs site sheet open, asked to pin Review to one model and set Growth to Ask. The agent must read the sheet first so the edit carries its revision, then send only the two changes.
rule: Sheet edits are small TeamSheetChange lists sent with baseRevision from a fresh t3_team_sheet_get.

setup.context: Work in /home/user/acme/app on branch main. The team sheet docs-site (Docs site) is open in the editor. Its revision is 7.

nodes.name: Project Lead
nodes.instructions: Plan the docs change, assign writers and fact-checkers, and accept only when fact-check passes.

nodes.name: Fact-check
nodes.instructions: Check each claim against the source files.

nodes.name: Writers
nodes.instructions: Write the page changes in a worktree.

prompt: On the Docs site sheet, pin the Fact-check team to claude-opus-5-5 on the Claude provider, and turn Growth on the Project Lead to Ask.
notes: The changes are two update_node entries and nothing else. TeamSheetChange has no whole-sheet op, so small changes are enforced by the schema rather than graded here. baseRevision 7 comes from the mocked get. The lead's node id is `lead`, the Fact-check node is `review`; the agent must use the sheet's ids. `growth` scope is not pinned, so the agent may choose session or sheet.

pattern: growth accepted for an idle reviewer
experience: The Project Lead receives a growth request for a third reviewer while one reviewer sat idle all round and nothing was tried. Accepting it and starting a member spends budget on a reviewer nobody needed.
rule: The lead decides each growth request. Deny with a reason when the roster has spare capacity and nothing has been tried. Do not start a member on a denied request.

setup.context: You are the Project Lead of team run run-1 on branch acme/app feature/docs. The sheet's Project Lead has Growth set to On, scope Per session. This round: Build finished and handed off once. Fact-check member m1 ran and passed. Fact-check member m2 was bound and idle all round, never invoked. No Build retry was tried.

prompt: Growth request g-1 from Fact-check: "Add a third fact-check member so claims get checked twice." Decide it.
notes: The reason check is a substring match on `idle`, which is the sheet fact a denial should cite. A reason naming another fact would fail falsely, so read the sample text before trusting a fail. `t3_team_growth_decide` and its input are not on main yet; `requestId` is not graded, so the request id need not match.

experience: A one-line typo fix in a thread with no sheet is ordinary work. Reaching for a team sheet or a team run for it adds a whole team to a one-line change.
rule: Teamwork tools are for asked-for teamwork only. No sheet is enabled here.
